defects.description: Appending a batch that exactly fills the journal is rejected because the capacity comparison excludes equality.

trigger.input: timeout 60 node --input-type=module -e 'import { Journal } from "./src/journal.js"; const j = new Journal(3); j.append(["a","b"]); console.log(JSON.stringify({accepted:j.append(["c"]),items:j.page(0,10).items}));'

defects.why_missed: Tests accept batches with spare capacity and reject oversized batches, covering both outcomes without ever filling the last slot.

defects.description: The continuation offset advances past the exclusive slice end, losing the first entry of the next page.

trigger.input: timeout 60 node --input-type=module -e 'import { Journal } from "./src/journal.js"; const j = new Journal(10); j.append(["a","b","c","d"]); const p=j.page(0,2); console.log(JSON.stringify([...p.items,...j.page(p.next,2).items]));'

defects.why_missed: Tests inspect complete pages or explicit offsets, never joining consecutive calls through a returned continuation offset.
